items.author: John Dilworth
items.stickyText: Create a more techish looking site rather than Lucid default style. Use basic styling from "Desig Loop" for fonts and color scheme on the site. INclude the background shader animation used on Design Loop also.
items.instruction: Swap the site's type and colour tokens in styles.css for Design Loop's (fonts, accent colours, surfaces), and port Design Loop's AsciiBackground canvas animation to a small inline vanilla-JS canvas behind the hero (no external scripts; static frame for reduced motion and during capture). Done together with item 3, since Design Loop's palette is dark.

items.author: John Dilworth
items.stickyText: Revert headline back to "Turn every sticky note into a pull request"
items.instruction: Set the hero h1 to "Turn every sticky note into a pull request" (and the page title/meta description to match if they use the current headline).

items.author: John Dilworth
items.stickyText: Add darkmode to the site — and make dark the default.
items.instruction: Add a dark theme as the default with a sun/moon toggle in the header that remembers the choice (localStorage, no external code); recolour the section bands (orange, teal, grey) and SVG icon strokes for dark. Pairs with item 1.

items.author: John Dilworth
items.stickyText:
Add a section to explain the approval flow that allows collaboration, but also keeps changes in approval flow by specific people - highlight the different modes:

Auto - run on autopilot, incorporating changes on a regular schedule automatically. 

Manual - run a harvest at your own schedule

---

Approver mode — let's an assigned individual manually approve and adjust each change before it is incorporated into code.
items.instruction: Add a new "You choose who approves" section after the Review/Harvest/Ship/Repeat loop with three cards: Auto, Manual and Approver mode, using the sticky's descriptions (copy tidied), plus a nav link if it fits.

items.author: John Dilworth
items.stickyText: Make each of these icons an "X"    or cancel emoji so it's clear these are problems that exist with  current software.
items.instruction: Replace the three problem-card SVG icons with a matching red X-in-circle icon (inline SVG, not emoji, so it renders the same everywhere).

items.author: John Dilworth
items.stickyText: Update the site with screenshots from "harvest dashboard" project
items.instruction: Capture current Harvest Dashboard pages (home cards, single-page project view, approval list) at harvest-dashboard.netlify.app, add them as compressed .webp images (each well under 2 MB) and use them in the 'Works with your agents' area and the evolution/proof section in place of the older Design Loop shots where they fit. Which spots to replace is a judgement call; say so if you want them somewhere specific.
